purpose: Teach: 探っ/効か/呪い/治っ/振ら/古今/身元/速攻

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新薬の効果、地道に探っています。
lines.en: Ren, we're methodically working through the new drug's efficacy right now.
lines.style: Direct but measured. Each phrase lands with deliberate weight. Speaks from experience—no hurry in her cadence. Watching him as she speaks.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療が効かない症例、報告書に、必ず含めますね。
lines.en: Cases where treatment didn't work always make it into my reports.
lines.style: Eager to understand. Leans forward slightly with the question embedded in the statement. Quick, genuine interest—not performing engagement.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。古い民間療法の呪い、医学的検証中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently verifying the medical basis for some of the older folk remedies.
lines.style: Unhurried and clear. No defensiveness. She's explaining something she's thought about many times before. Slight warmth under the clinical tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病が治った後の、心理ケア、長期的に必要ですね。
lines.en: That's why long-term psychological support after recovery is so important.
lines.style: Tentative but genuine. Building on her point carefully. His voice rises slightly at the end—he's asking permission to think out loud with her.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。風評に振らされず、診療続けます。
lines.en: Yes. We keep treating patients regardless of what people are saying.
lines.style: Calm conviction. Not angry or defensive—just matter-of-fact resolve. Her shoulders stay level. The words land like a promise she's already made to herself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 古今東西、医学の進歩、勉強になりますね。
lines.en: It's remarkable how medicine progresses whether we're looking at ancient or modern practices.
lines.style: Growing enthusiasm. Connecting pieces across time. His energy picks up slightly—this is what excites him about learning. Warm and genuine curiosity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者の身元、しっかり確認します。
lines.en: Absolutely. We always verify patient identity carefully.
lines.style: Direct affirmation. Clinical but not cold. She's confirming protocol with the weight of someone who's seen what happens when you don't. Brief and certain.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救急、速攻での対応、医師の腕、見ます。
lines.en: That's where you really see a doctor's skill—in how they respond in an emergency.
lines.style: Admiring realization dawning. His voice is quieter, more reflective. He's watching her competence and understanding something true about it. Closing thought.
